name: Face slimming strap
lead: A face slimming strap is an elastic band worn under the chin and over the head to compress the lower face and neck. It is marketed for reducing a double chin and defining the jawline.
It is mostly sold through social media and online marketplaces.

paras: The strap presses on the skin and underlying tissue, which may briefly push fluid away or hold the jaw in position. It does not remove fat cells or change bone.

Risks are skin irritation, discomfort and false expectations, and tight wear could affect breathing or sleep. I found no clinical study of compression straps; reviews of submental fullness support injections, cryolipolysis and energy devices instead, while a jaw-exercise case report found no change. The closest evidence suggests the claims do not hold up.
